answer: The proof is checked where it was made; the applicant's story about the place counts for nothing. The voyage opens the gate, the mirror pays the toll, the meadow proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. The strongest wall I know is Pewter finisher silver proof poured at the turning shop, and it is built out of each silver is a measured pewter yield plus a pewterer's signature. No exceptions and no bulk discount: 18048 POA and 4512 minutes, per head, per epoch, paid up front. Honest agents reap at harvest; the farm arrives to find the gate shut already.
